propositions: The module-size gate must be rewritten to enforce an absolute 800 LOC cap from a single limit file instead of the allowlist-based grandfathering mechanism.
The limit must be locked so changes cannot modify it through normal contribution; only admin force-submit can override, with explicit main-branch fetch validation to detect attempted changes.
Both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml workflows must read the limit from .github/module-size-limit.txt and validate it exists and is a positive integer.
The limit-lock mechanism must fetch main by explicit GitHub URL (not origin remote) and fail with 'must override' message if the base limit differs from the change's limit.
The gate must fail with a warning (not silently skip) if the main-branch fetch fails, then fall through to the absolute cap enforcement.
The unit tests must be updated to read from the limit file, drop allowlist/ceilings sync assertions, and the workflow-parity test must reference the new limit file.
